cohort: The study included 193 cases of prenatal "dilated bowel" identified on ultrasound, with 12 specifically having a prominent or dilated rectum, excluding ventral wall defects.
finding: While a prenatal dilated rectum is a normal variant in the majority of cases, it can be associated with gastrointestinal abnormalities requiring surgical intervention, though no cases of Hirschsprung's disease or anorectal malformations were found in this cohort.
